name: resume
description: Show where the work stands. With both record_id and snapshot_digest from a prior resume, return that stored record as JSON data only. A stale binding is refused; an unknown record remains not verified. Reading does not approve content or grant authority.

record_id.description: Original record ID from resume; requires snapshot_digest

snapshot_digest.description: Original bundle SHA-256 from the same resume; requires record_id

name: add_recommendation
description: Record a recommendation. This is a proposal only. It does not decide anything and does not authorize any action. The record is attributed to the connected client.

name: check_decision
description: Before acting, ask whether a recorded decision meets the policy. allow does not prove the responsible party has Authority and does not run anything; read not_verified in the result.

decision.description: Id of the recorded decision the action relies on

deny_unresolved.description: Deny when the decision left questions unresolved

require_recommendation.description: Deny when no recorded recommendation is relied on by the decision

scope.description: Scope of that decision. Required when the same id exists in more than one scope; an empty string names the decision with no scope. Without it, an id that matches several decisions is denied as ambiguous

annotations.title: Check decision (appends to the gate log)

name: add_decision
description: Record a decision made by a named responsible party. A decision needs someone to answer for it: responsible is required. The record is attributed to the connected client.

recommendation.description: Ids of recorded recommendations this decision relies on; each must already exist in the store

responsible.description: Who answers for this decision, written kind:id (at least one)
